quarterly_data.quarter: Hirano Tecseed semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half (April-September 2025): net sales JPY 18,157 million (-25.5%), operating income JPY 1,209 million (+18.0%), ordinary income JPY 1,275 million (+6.1%), net income attributable to owners of parent JPY 901 million (+3.9%). Management states machinery workload fell with the global EV slowdown although energy-related ancillary construction in North America was relatively firm, and that revised order terms on some projects partly offset higher material and labor costs and storage / subcontractor costs from delivery postponement requests. It cites EU and US environmental policy shifts, US tariff policy and oversupply of secondary batteries in China as the reasons it revised the medium-term plan.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hirano Tecseed semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half orders received JPY 7,397,624 thousand (-60.2%), order backlog JPY 36,799,562 thousand (-22.6% from the fiscal year-end). Coating and laminating machinery: orders JPY 5,428,846 thousand (-66.3%), backlog JPY 30,713,012 thousand (-23.9%; domestic JPY 7,074 million, +30.6%; export JPY 23,638 million, -32.3%), sales JPY 15,051 million (-27.0%). Industrial (chemical) machinery: orders JPY 1,389,515 thousand (-19.2%), backlog JPY 5,611,650 thousand (-14.1%), sales JPY 2,309 million (-21.5%) as sales of its core film-forming equipment for electronic materials were weak; segment profit JPY 397 million (+62.8%).
